why: owner 25 Nov: the game blocked MultiBarBottomRightButtonContainer1:SetShown() in combat

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.2-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

Fixes
- Combat: the addon no longer replaces the game's red error text function (UIErrorsFrame.AddMessage). That replacement made the game's own code count as tainted and the game then blocked its action bar calls in combat (the 'Interface actions failed because of this AddOn' count). The Persian alerts now ride a safe hook instead and look the same.
- The blocked-call logger now also records which game file and line made the blocked call, so a remaining case can be named exactly.
